_doc: NPC portrait generation spec for the dialog system. Portraits are 96×96 pixel art busts used in NpcDialogScene. Generated via PixelLab create_map_object (side view, 96×96).

_artDirection.style: anime-tech-meets-fantasy pixel art. Organic materials (fur, leather, cloth) with subtle geometric precision — clean edges, deliberate highlights, no anti-aliasing.
_artDirection.framing: Bust portrait — head + shoulders + upper chest. Centered, facing slightly left (3/4 view toward the text area). Transparent background.
_artDirection.palette: Rich but restrained. 8-12 colors per portrait. Warm skin tones, culturally-distinct clothing accents. Dark outlines (selective outline style).
_artDirection.shading: Medium shading — enough for depth and expression without over-rendering. Consistent top-left light source across all portraits.
_artDirection.resolution: 96×96 pixels. No sub-pixel tricks. Every pixel deliberate.
_artDirection.outline: Selective outline — thicker on silhouette edges, thinner or absent on internal detail.
_artDirection.mood: Each NPC should feel like a person with a life. Expression matches their spriteNotes personality.

_descriptionTemplate: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. [Race body — build, skin, head features]. [Clothing from fashion variant — visible collar/shoulders/headwear]. [Expression and personality from spriteNotes]. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, warm palette.
_priority: Phase 1 = NPCs the player interacts with most (dialog-heavy roles). Phase 2 = remaining building NPCs. Phase 3 = ambient NPCs.

phase1_dialog_heavy._note: Core NPCs the player talks to regularly. Generate these first — they appear in the dialog box.

portraits.name: Settlement Chief
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Medium-build human, weathered olive skin, strong jawline, short cropped hair with grey at temples. Elder-variant clothing — heavy fur-lined mantle over layered tunic, bronze clasp at shoulder. Confident stern expression, arms-crossed posture implied. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, warm earthy palette.

portraits.name: Blacksmith
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Short-broad dwarf, ruddy tan skin, thick braided beard with soot streaks, broad nose, heavy brow. Artisan clothing — leather apron over bare muscular shoulders, forge goggles pushed up on forehead. Focused squinting expression, slight grin. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, warm orange-brown palette.

portraits.name: Innkeeper
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Stout human, warm brown skin, round friendly face, double chin, receding hairline with tied-back ponytail. Common clothing — clean linen shirt with rolled sleeves, cloth over one shoulder. Warm welcoming smile, rosy cheeks. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, warm amber palette.

portraits.name: Market Master
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Lean sharp-featured human, pale skin, thin greying mustache, narrow calculating eyes, high cheekbones. Elder clothing — embroidered collar coat, quill tucked behind ear, ink-stained fingers visible at chest. Sharp evaluating expression. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, cool blue-grey palette.

portraits.name: Priest
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Tall slender elf, pale green-tinted skin, angular features, pointed ears, long white hair braided with small leaves. Ceremonial robes — layered silk with geometric embroidery at collar, subtle glow-thread accents. Serene knowing expression, half-lidded eyes. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, cool green-silver palette.

portraits.name: Mage
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Wiry human, dark skin, sharp intelligent eyes with faint arcane glow, close-cropped silver hair, angular face. Ceremonial robe — high collar with geometric rune patterns, crystal pendant at throat, subtle tech-circuit motifs in fabric. Intense focused expression. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, deep purple-blue palette.

portraits.name: Barkeep
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Broad-shouldered human, tanned skin, square jaw, bushy eyebrows, thick forearms visible. Common clothing — dark vest over white shirt, sleeves rolled past elbows, bar towel draped over shoulder. Gruff but amused expression, one eyebrow raised. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, warm brown-red palette.

portraits.name: Gate Guard
portraits.description: Pixel art bust portrait, 3/4 view facing left, transparent background. Athletic human, light skin with a scar across nose bridge, close-cropped dark hair under open-face helmet. Warrior clothing — chainmail collar visible under fur-lined cloak, leather shoulder guard. Alert watchful expression, jaw set. Anime-tech-meets-fantasy style, selective outline, steel-grey and brown palette.

phase3_ambient_and_generic._note: Ambient NPCs and generic roles. Lower priority — some may use shared portraits.

_notes: Each portrait costs ~1 generation (create_map_object, single image).
Culture-specific variants (same role, different race/fashion) can be added later by cloning a description and swapping race + fashion fields.
Portraits are race-generic defaults. For culture-specific settlements, generate variant portraits with the matching ancestry + fashion.
Wildkin (beastkin) portraits will need separate descriptions per clan line (Wolf-clan, Bear-clan, Fox-clan etc.) — schedule as a separate batch.
